items.title: Agent Framework orchestration patterns reach 1.0
items.route: orchestration selection, bounded Magentic composition and maturity coordinates.
items.annotation: orchestration builders are higher-level constructors over ordinary workflows; choose deterministic sequential/concurrent patterns when routing must stay fixed; use explicit bounds for manager-driven patterns.
items.limitations: production Code Interpreter, unbounded autonomous loops, or cross-language API-name substitution. GA builder does not make a particular prompt/tool topology safe.
